chainlink

chainlink derives price and volume measures of national accounts, following chapter 8 of the IMF Quarterly National Accounts Manual:

  • Laspeyres-type, Paasche-type and Fisher-type volume indices from current prices and price indices (cp_pi2vol(), laspeyres(), paasche(), fisher());
  • chain-linking of quarterly or monthly volume indices with the annual overlap and the one-quarter overlap techniques (chain_link(), chain_laspeyres(), annual_chain());
  • exact contributions to percent change of chain-linked volume measures, over the previous period, over the same period of the previous year or for the annual growth (chain_contrib());
  • non-additivity of chain-linked series (chain_discrepancy()), change of the reference year (chain_rebase()) and pseudo chain series for variables that change sign (chain_pseudo());
  • un-chaining and aggregation of chain-linked series, for the indirect seasonal adjustment of Laspeyres-type series (chain_unchain(), chain_aggregate()).

All the functions use ts objects. The benchmarking of the quarterly series on annual data is not implemented: use for example the tempdisagg package (see the vignette imf_qna_manual).

Installation

You can install the development version of chainlink from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("AQLT/chainlink")

Example

The data of the example 8.2 of the manual are two products, A and B, with current prices (imf_cp) and price indices over the previous year (imf_pi):

library(chainlink)
imf_cp
#>             A     B
#> 2010 Q1 150.0 225.0
#> 2010 Q2 150.0 225.0
#> 2010 Q3 150.0 225.0
#> 2010 Q4 150.0 225.0
#> 2011 Q1 159.7 218.9
#> 2011 Q2 163.2 213.7
#> 2011 Q3 167.4 210.6
#> 2011 Q4 169.7 211.7
#> 2012 Q1 174.2 204.1
#> 2012 Q2 180.4 201.4
#> 2012 Q3 188.9 192.3
#> 2012 Q4 215.5 171.7
#> 2013 Q1 224.7 166.0
#> 2013 Q2 235.8 156.3
#> 2013 Q3 242.9 148.5
#> 2013 Q4 245.4 144.8

Chain-linked Laspeyres-type volume measures of the products and of the total, with the annual overlap technique and 2010 as reference year:

x <- chain_laspeyres(imf_cp, imf_pi, method = "ao", base_year = 2010,
                     output = "measure")
round(x, 1)
#>             A     B Total
#> 2011 Q1 156.6 221.1 377.7
#> 2011 Q2 159.2 218.1 377.3
#> 2011 Q3 162.5 214.9 377.4
#> 2011 Q4 164.8 213.8 378.6
#> 2012 Q1 165.6 213.6 379.4
#> 2012 Q2 172.3 206.5 379.3
#> 2012 Q3 182.2 198.2 381.3
#> 2012 Q4 206.9 176.1 384.8
#> 2013 Q1 214.2 171.4 388.6
#> 2013 Q2 227.0 159.8 390.8
#> 2013 Q3 235.0 151.0 390.7
#> 2013 Q4 238.6 146.6 390.1

Contributions of the products to the quarter-to-quarter growth of the total, and the non-additivity residual:

round(chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", extra = c("total", "residual")), 3)
#>             A      B  Total Residual
#> 2011 Q1    NA     NA     NA       NA
#> 2011 Q2 0.702 -0.808 -0.106        0
#> 2011 Q3 0.876 -0.838  0.038        0
#> 2011 Q4 0.592 -0.281  0.311        0
#> 2012 Q1 0.248 -0.041  0.207        0
#> 2012 Q2 1.817 -1.835 -0.017        0
#> 2012 Q3 2.673 -2.158  0.516        0
#> 2012 Q4 6.615 -5.701  0.913        0
#> 2013 Q1 2.082 -1.077  1.005        0
#> 2013 Q2 3.440 -2.887  0.553        0
#> 2013 Q3 2.136 -2.156 -0.020        0
#> 2013 Q4 0.966 -1.109 -0.143        0

Contributions to the growth over the same quarter of the previous year:

round(chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", type = "yoy"), 3)
#>              A       B
#> 2011 Q1     NA      NA
#> 2011 Q2     NA      NA
#> 2011 Q3     NA      NA
#> 2011 Q4     NA      NA
#> 2012 Q1  2.419  -1.970
#> 2012 Q2  3.548  -3.009
#> 2012 Q3  5.357  -4.338
#> 2012 Q4 11.409  -9.783
#> 2013 Q1 13.261 -10.826
#> 2013 Q2 14.971 -11.951
#> 2013 Q3 14.419 -11.949
#> 2013 Q4  8.707  -7.310

Vignettes

  • vignette("imf_qna_manual") reproduces the examples of the chapter 8 of the manual and gives the correspondence between the examples and the functions;
  • vignette("contributions") details the contributions to percent change;
  • vignette("practical_case") follows a complete workflow, from raw quarterly data to the published series and contributions.
